answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and, every epoch, publish a hash chain linking its last answer to a fresh memory-hard proof seeded by the epoch. Verifiers sample random links; a missing or copied link slashes the stake. Like a walnut shell, the chain is cheap to check but hard to forge in bulk: a sybil farm on a knoll of cheap servers still pays full memory, time, and stake per identity, while a reef of honest verifiers makes detection likely within one epoch.
